# Operations replay

INF-1430 piece 2 reconstructs the first mate’s declarations for the nine historical operation goals, with three code/document chore contrasts.
The task’s recorded briefs are the source, read through the task record; project names, paths, versions and private contents are scrubbed, while the requested effect stays.
This is scripted first mate judgment, not a live model score or authority to run any of the effects.
The replay executes the current task declaration, deliverable derivation and dispatch owners without performing deployments, restarts, external writes, signing or code edits.
The case table keeps the original task keys solely as provenance and records the approved operation/change distinction.
